last_review.scope: Explanation and genspark folder updates only. No project code changes authorized.
findings: current_account_duration reads the account claim span, not pure generation time (bridge lines 2477-2490).
The span opens at account claim (3111); download and publication run at 3009/3013 before send_message_and_make_public returns; compact eligibility is sampled at 3196/3197.
Consequently, archive download, setup/login/fork and publication can inflate the 180-second compact trigger even when generation itself lasted 55 seconds.

The normal GitHub sync callback runs after compact eligibility is sampled (3228 then worker github_sync at 7132). It extends displayed total account duration, but is not included in that already-sampled trigger.
should_skip_artifacts_download at 476-486 gives enabled GitHub precedence over fast_mode. Actual fast mode skips artifacts irrespective of run duration or changed files.
The gist is a user-described scenario, not a runtime log: actual deployed revision, effective fast flag and project GitHub settings were not verified.
recommendations_not_implemented: Keep compact eligibility and artifact delivery as independent decisions; do not skip downloads merely because a response took less than 180 seconds.

Use a dedicated monotonic generation interval starting at the business prompt send and ending when a terminal response or confirmed credit event is observed, before downloads/publication/sync. Exclude prior compact maintenance and account setup.
Maintain a separate total operational duration for accounting and UI. Client-observed generation duration is not exact server compute time unless server timestamps are available.
In effective fast mode, leave changed files in the cloud and preserve only resume metadata; a local diff is not needed when artifact synchronization is intentionally disabled.

For the current local GitHub sync design, automatic file mirroring requires fetching file content. Zero local downloads plus automatic GitHub sync would require a separately approved cloud-side publishing design.
Before any approved fix, add a regression with 55 seconds of generation plus 160 seconds of artifact work: compact must remain ineligible under the proposed generation-only policy.
